sloka: ततः पुष्येऽभिषिञ्चस्व मनस्त्वरयतीव माम् ।श्वस्त्वाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि यौवराज्ये परंतप ॥२-४-२२॥
transliteration: tataḥ puṣye'bhiṣiñcasva manastvarayatīva mām ।śvastvāhamabhiṣekṣyāmi yauvarājye paraṁtapa ॥2-4-22॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ My mind is hastening me saying, 'Coronate Rama in the Pushya constellation itself'. O Slayer of enemies, I shall install you heir apparent tomorrow.
